segments.text: I omit many other ſentences of the holy ſcriptures, which euidentlie appeare to be expounded by figures of all ſuch as iudge godlie: for if I would recken them vp, I ſhould now make no abridgement, but a large booke: Therefore when we thus interprete this ſentence of ours, we bring in no new thing or that which is repugnāt to the Scriptures.
